code_review: workspace_init resets speaker_profile=false on original prepare and tap-cue paths; only the temporary replacement render sets true.

helper validates plan/counts/target/frame count, nonoverlapping sample ranges and finite input buffers before allocation or writes; output stays private until all rendering/normalization/Harmony filtering succeeds.
Only memcpy to FULL publishes data. Source/Foreground/target/plan are read only. Dust returns without allocation or mutation.

New harmonics are synthesized per note. Voice and Harmony frequency guards exclude harmonics at/above Nyquist; unsigned Harmony phase multiplication implements modulo phase without out-of-range table indexing.

One567216-byte temporary heap allocation on host ABI. workspace327216,extraFULL240000; old prepare workspace is freed before this allocation. Existing live and newly prepared loop banks remain resident.

prepare_worker invokes office band helper between prepare and calibration, selects separate office role gains, and uses mutually exclusive office/old-Harmony preprocessor branches plus compile-time conflict error.
Failed office DSP leaves calibration_failed false and invalidates job via band helper, so owner retains old valid sound rather than converting the failure into hardware shutdown.

Existing in-repo bad-input tests cover NAN target and one partial buffer alias but do not explicitly retain zero/subnormal-target regressions; the limited output-only probe passed.
Current fresh-prepare isolation check compares two executions of the modified renderer. The independent HEAD-vs-candidate ordinary comparison above closes that gap for the specified12case/cue corpus.
